edition_note: Hindi bhashya summarized in own words; 2021 commentary is in-copyright, only brief fair-use quotes. Ancient Sanskrit verses are public domain.
whole_work: 35 prakashas planned, ~15000 shlokas; Shiva-Parvati samvada after Jalandhara defeat; 108 tantras, Meru supreme like Sumeru

prakashas.name: Samskara
topics: 10 mantra-samskaras: janana, jivana, tadana, bodhana, abhisheka, vimalikarana, apyayana, tarpana, dipana, gopana
game_hooks: mantra crafting: 10 purification steps as upgrade track

prakashas.name: Diksha
topics: kunda mana: chatushkona, vritta, shadasra, ashtasra, ashtadala, panchasra, saptasra
vaidika + tantrika sarvatobhadra mandala, deva-wise vidhi, mandala-vidhi, varuna mandala
game_hooks: calendar picker: shubha muhurta for pratishta
diksha type per path (vag/shambhavi for advanced)

prakashas.name: Ahnika
topics: murti avahana + puja, dipadana, naivedya, bhutabali
game_hooks: nyasa tap-sequence minigames per matrika set

prakashas.name: Purashcharya
topics: mala vichara, rudraksha phala/mahima, mala-samskara/bheda, shudra-stri prayojya mala, karamala
purashcharana bhojana, japa samaya, mantra-siddhi upaya
game_hooks: japa counter (mala beads) with sthana/asana/bhojana buffs

prakashas.name: Siddhi-sthirikarana
game_hooks: DEFENSE-ONLY framing: stambhana (shield), shanti (heal), uchchatana (repel saboteurs); marana/vashikarana shown in philosophy tab only, never playable
siddhi decay meter stabilized by nitya duties

prakashas.name: Mudra-lakshana
topics: ~100 mudras: ankusha, kantha, vahni-prakara, anguli-nyasa, hridaya/shira/shikha/kavacha, trinetra/dvinetra, lalita-namaskara, kshobhini/dravini/akarshini, galini, dhanuh, shankha, yoni, matsya, avahani/sthapani/sammukhikarani/sakalikarani/avagunthana/sannidhapana/sannirodhana, ... gayatri 24, sumukha/samputa/vitata/vistrita/dvi-tri-chatur-pancha-shan-mukha/adhomukha/vyapak-anjali, ...
game_hooks: mudra gesture minigame (trace/shape match) per puja step
upachara 16-step offering sequence as core temple loop
